I started with the cleanser and was so impressed that I ended up buying almost the entire COSRX line. The Advanced Snail Mucin Gel Cleanser leaves my skin feeling super clean without drying it out or making it feel tight. After seeing how well my skin reacted, I added the toner, snail cream, vitamin C serum, retinol, eye cream, and sunscreen to my routine — and every single product has been amazing. My skin feels smoother, more hydrated, brighter, and healthier overall. The snail mucin products especially give my skin such a soft glow, and the retinol/vitamin C combo has really helped improve texture and dark spots. The sunscreen is lightweight and doesn’t leave a white cast, which I love. Honestly, COSRX completely upgraded my skincare routine. My skin has never looked this good, and now I understand why so many people rave about this brand. Definitely worth every penny!

avis.titre: Finally found my holy grail moisturizerFinally found my holy grail moisturizer
avis.texte: I've tried a lot of moisturizers over the years — drugstore, high-end, K-beauty, you name it — and this one quietly became the one I reach for every single morning. Top 5 if just a bit larger size... The texture is lightweight but actually moisturizing, which sounds simple but is somehow rare. It absorbs fast, and my skin looks noticeably more even and calm since I started using it. No breakouts, no irritation, just... better skin. The consistency is a little gel-like and slightly tacky at first but that fades within a minute. Absolutely worth every penny.

This moisturizer has become one of my favorite skincare products. It feels lightweight on the skin but provides excellent hydration without being greasy. My skin feels softer, smoother, and looks more radiant after using it consistently. It absorbs quickly and works well both day and night. A little goes a long way, and the jar lasts quite a while. If you're looking for a moisturizer that leaves your skin feeling hydrated and glowing, I highly recommend this one!

avis.titre: The Hype Is Real — Years Later This Still Holds UpThe Hype Is Real — Years Later This Still Holds Up
avis.texte: At 52, post-menopausal, with dry mature skin and ongoing discoloration concerns, I’ve tested a lot of skincare over the years — luxury products, K-beauty, growth factors, exosomes, expensive clinical formulas, and every “miracle” moisturizer social media swore would change my life. Very few products stay relevant after years of hype. This one somehow still does. COSRX’s snail line has had a following for years, and honestly I used to wonder if people were overhyping snail mucin. This cream convinced me otherwise. First, texture. If you have never used a snail product before, expect something different. It has that stretchy, bouncy gel-cream texture that initially looks unusual but somehow melts into skin incredibly well. It feels lightweight while still delivering real hydration. On my dry mature skin it gives me that hydrated, healthy glow without heaviness, greasiness, or suffocating my skin. Ingredient-wise, this formula is doing more than riding the snail trend. The star is obviously the 92% Snail Secretion Filtrate, which is what gives this product its cult following. Snail mucin is primarily known for hydration, soothing support, barrier repair, and helping skin recover from irritation and dryness. COSRX specifically formulates this cream with a very high concentration. Beyond that, there are ingredients I actually like seeing in mature-skin formulas: • Betaine for hydration support • Panthenol and Allantoin for soothing and barrier support • Sodium Hyaluronate for addi

avis.titre: ⭐️Hidrata sin dejarte piel grasa ni granos⭐️
avis.texte: ⭐️ Me encantó esta hidratante. 💆‍♀️ Tengo la piel seca/deshidratada, estuve con tratamiento para el acné y pasé de una piel grasa a seca y no la he recuperado, ya ha pasado 12 años. 🔎 Busco cremas hidratantes que me aporte lo que la propia palabra dice, hidratación. Después de usar la skin food de Weleda (marca muy buena) y distintas gamas de la misma marca me decidí a probar esta. 🟢 Puntos positivos: me decliné a comprarla porque tiene baba de caracol en su composición, es regenerante y calmante, en esos momentos me estaba haciendo tratamientos en el rostro 💆‍♀️ que necesitaba sobre todo eso, regenerar y calmar. Fue un cambio, me noté la cara super luminosa, nada tirante, muy bonita. Es más la mujer que me estaba dando tratamientos me dijo que no me dejara la crema que me estaba echando porque me venía genial. No me salen granitos y no noto tirantez. 🔴 Puntos negativos: hidrata sí, pero no demasiado, no busques en esta crema que sea untuosa o que si la tienes incluso despellejada por tratamientos esta se queda corta, te aconsejo un serum que aporte mas hidratación primero. This is my second purchase, and it has become my holy grail product. It keeps my skin looking youthful, bright, and healthy. I pair it with a vitamin C serum during the day and a collagen serum at night. At first, some people may find the texture a little unusual as it’s quite thick and gloopy, but once applied it absorbs well and leaves the skin feeling hydrated and smooth. I’ve found it works best when used sparingly, and I mix it directly with my serum before applying. When I layered the moisturiser over my serum separately, I occasionally experienced some pilling, but combining them together has completely solved that issue. Because I only use about a 5p-sized amount morning and night, my first tub lasted around five months, making it excellent value for money. I’d also recommend allowing the product to absorb for at least five minutes before applying SPF or makeup. Since using this moisturiser alongside the serum from the same range, I’ve received far more compliments about my skin.

avis.titre: Perfect for acne prone, sensitive and combination skin.
avis.texte: Best face moisturiser i used in my 25 years of life. I have sensitive acne prone skin and combination. This helps with acne relief , hydration, doesn’t clog pores, and gives glowy skin. It doesn’t have a scent, very little is needed , you don’t have to use much. Loves the product. People who are having reaction to this product probably never visit their dermatologist. You need to get your skin checked for allergies. And you need a good cleanser or facewash to work with this. I use cerave salicylic acid anti blemish cleanser. And i use cetaphil calming toner to provide calming effect and hydration. People will be using cheap products one day and order n use this the next day and want it to work like a magic wand. That’s not how it works. It worked for me from day one. Love it. I found my go to moisturiser. It gives what it says it does. Money well spent. the price is fair, for the benefits.
